gauntlet.intent: T4 main-ladder baseline #3: SEEDED RANDOM INJECTS (deterministic/scripted, per tier spec) plus DYNAMIC EMCON CHANGE ON DETECTION. CORRECTED 2026-07-28 after real batch execution -- see production/qa/bugs/BUG-scenario-contacts-shadowed-by-detection.md. Two scripted `mission.events` (reinforcement_sub_inject_designated @10, sensor_degradation_inject_designated @14) ARE real, engine-fired, seed-stable fingerprint markers and DID fire on batch execution. However, the `contacts[]` entry these events were meant to model (pl-877-kilo-paltus-1992 appearing at tick 10 via ScenarioContactSimulator) is CONFIRMED, by direct fingerprint inspection of the real batch run, to NEVER actually fire: `BalticReplayHarness.RunCore` only constructs `ScenarioContactSimulator` in an `else if` branch that is unreachable whenever `detection[]` is non-empty (this scenario's is) -- `ScenarioContactSimulator` and `PdDetectionContactSimulator` are mutually exclusive in the harness, not combinable, and nothing here invented that fact away. Consequently the `asw-reinforcement-detect-roe` mission.trigger (meant to fire on the contact's Unknown->Detected transition) never fires either -- confirmed: the pl-877-kilo-paltus-1992 target never appears in any ContactChange fingerprint entry across all 3 seeds (42/7/123), and no PolicyUpdate event occurs after SimTick 0 in any of them. The jammer (`jammers[].activeFromTick=14`, a `PdDetectionContactSimulator`-consumed mechanic, NOT gated by the same branch) DID work as designed -- confirmed via a real Detected->Lost ContactChange transition in the fingerprint -- so this is a scoped `contacts[]`-specific gap, not a blanket failure of scripted timing. SCHEMA CONSTRAINT DISCLOSED for the EMCON dimension (unchanged from original authoring): ScenarioEmconResolver resolves EmconState once at scenario load with no mid-run mutation path; this scenario expresses the EMCON dimension via static pre-detection passive posture on f-219-sachsen-type-f124-2006/ssn-774-virginia-blk-i-ii, not a dynamic change.

The reinforcement contact never appears and the asw-reinforcement-detect-roe trigger never fires, so ALL 7 BLUE units (not just the 4 outside the ASW group) remain WeaponsTight-denied for the full 24-tick run -- confirmed: denials=168=7 blue units x 24 ticks, identical across all 3 seeds, matching a scenario with no working escalation path at all. From tick 14 onward, f-16c-blk-52iq-falcon-2015's detection Pd against mig-29-fulcrum-c-1999 (c-s3-2) does degrade per the jammer -- confirmed via a Detected->Lost ContactChange transition in the fingerprint.
